spec.claim_rule: A contrast (A,B) is SUPPORTED for a claim-eligible family only if, in EVERY split and at EVERY density of that family, it is Holm-significant at parent level in the claimed direction AND the layout-level cluster-bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0 in the same direction (needs >= 5 layouts). EQUIVALENT only if the 95% CI of the relative RMSE difference lies inside +/- margin in every cell (needs >= 8 parents). Anything else is NOT SUPPORTED.
claims: H4 (primary): kgnn has lower RMSE than krig_global
H4b: kgnn has lower RMSE than idw; krig_global has lower RMSE than idw (replication of round 1)
H5 (primary): kgnn_side has lower RMSE than rk_side
H5b: kgnn_side vs krig_side; krig_side vs rk_side; kgnn_side vs kgnn
Nothing outside these lists is tested confirmatorily. Any other contrast computed from these results is exploratory and must be labelled so.
